title: Updating the Candidate-Code Register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $9$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its candidate-code field to $y$.
replaced:
For a register record $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $9$ of the
function listing its fifteen register values by $y$ gives the function listing the
values of the record obtained from $\sigma$ by setting its candidate-code value to $y$.
